items.stem: A workload needs to run stateless containers with automatic scaling to zero and no cluster management. Which service fits best?

options.rationale: That still requires VM and scaling management and does not scale to zero cleanly.
Correct: Cloud Run runs stateless containers, scales to zero and needs no cluster management.
GKE Standard requires managing the cluster.
Cloud Storage is object storage, not a compute service.

items.explanation: Correct: Cloud Run runs stateless containers, scales to zero and needs no cluster management.

items.stem: To grant least-privilege access, you should prefer:

options.text: Predefined or custom IAM roles scoped to the needed permissions
options.rationale: Correct: predefined/custom roles support least privilege.

options.text: The primitive Owner role for all users
options.rationale: Owner is overly broad and violates least privilege.

options.text: Sharing one service account key with everyone

options.rationale: IAM cannot be disabled and is required for access control.

items.explanation: Correct: predefined/custom roles support least privilege.

items.stem: Select TWO practices that improve a service's reliability per Google SRE principles.

options.text: Define SLOs and track an error budget
options.rationale: Correct: SLOs and error budgets are core SRE practices.

options.text: Remove all monitoring to reduce noise

options.rationale: Correct: redundancy across zones/regions improves availability.

options.text: Deploy straight to production without rollback
Treat an SLA as identical to an internal SLO
